U Myint Tun Appointed Managing Director at Golden Path Engineering

YANGON — Golden Path Engineering, a leading player in Myanmar’s Engineering & Construction sector, has announced the appointment of U Myint Tun as its new Managing Director, effective next month.

The company, best known for its infrastructure and commercial development projects across Yangon and Mandalay, confirmed the senior leadership change in a statement released on Monday morning. U Myint Tun succeeds Daw Hnin Yu Lwin, who is retiring after 12 years with the company.

“We are delighted to welcome U Myint Tun to the team,” said Golden Path Engineering’s Chairman, Ko Zaw Min Htet. “His extensive experience and leadership in major construction initiatives will be invaluable as we continue to drive innovation and growth, especially with several new projects set to break ground later this year.”

U Myint Tun brings more than 25 years of industry experience, having previously held senior management positions at a number of regional engineering firms. Speaking after the announcement, he said, “I am honoured to join Golden Path Engineering at a time of exciting opportunities for Myanmar’s construction sector. I look forward to working closely with our talented teams to deliver quality and sustainable solutions for our clients and communities.”

The Myanmar Engineering & Construction Association welcomed the appointment. “U Myint Tun’s track record in both public and private sector projects makes him an excellent choice,” said Daw May Thwe, the Association’s vice-chair. “His leadership comes at a time when the industry is seeing renewed investment and demand for infrastructure.”

Industry analysts note that Myanmar’s construction sector has shown resilience in recent years, with urban development and infrastructural upgrades continuing to progress. Golden Path Engineering’s leadership transition is seen as part of broader efforts by local firms to strengthen management and enhance project delivery standards.
